_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for the AUTH-GATED surface — the endpoints every earlier spec explicitly omitted because the runner was cookieless (TECH_DEBT #12). Requires a session: run with --auth-signup (bootstraps a throwaway user via POST /api/auth/signup and replays its Set-Cookie on every endpoint marked 'auth': true) or --auth-cookie NAME=VALUE. Only statically-checkable, environment-INDEPENDENT shapes are asserted. The PUT ai-key probe mutates only the throwaway signup user's Anthropic credential slot and asserts the provider-bootstrap shape — never the key/ciphertext. Owner gate (2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): the signed-up user is not on OWNER_EMAILS, so every owner-only read here (the three scan reads, and since this change the ticker bundle and stream, market-data, signals, strike-profile, contract, candidates and the recommendation post, export and status) asserts its 403 owner_only refusal; the scan envelopes the SEC-1 entries asserted moved, unchanged, to owner-gated.json, which runs with the owner's session.

INTERFACE user-accounts §2.6 — 401 anonymous, 200 bag signed-in. Default-created on first read; all three prefs nullable.
ai-providers bootstrap read — provider slots, Grok status, preference, catalog, and storage availability; NEVER a key or ciphertext.
ai-providers PUT stores one closed provider slot and returns the same secret-free bootstrap shape. Mutates the throwaway user only.
positions write gate (ARCHITECTURE §8a; [server-side-gate-enforcement] canon) — 403 anonymous, 200 {authorized:true} with a session. The signed-in 200 arm was previously unverifiable by this tool.
